name: Building Materials

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: A mixed-bag quarter
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Plastic pipes: healthy volumes but weak margins. Astral pipe volume +19% YoY with segment EBITDA margin down ~270bp YoY and QoQ; Supreme volume +24% YoY (+18% QoQ) but EBIT margin down ~80bp QoQ; Prince Pipe volume +22% YoY, +28% QoQ with ~13% EBITDA margin. Tiles: Kajaria volume +10% YoY, revenue +24%, EBITDA margin 19.5%; Cera revenue +24% but EBITDA margin 12.2%. Wood panels: Century Ply revenue/EBITDA/PAT +28%/32%/46%, EBITDA margin 12.9%, plywood margin 15.8% with MDF and particle board a drag. Guidance: Supreme cut FY27 volume growth to ~10% from 12%+ (margin 14-14.5%); Astral targets 15% consolidated margin from 13.1%; Kajaria expects double-digit tile volume growth and 18-20% margin; CPBI targets 20% MDF margin by FY29. No upgrades or downgrades.

unit_economics: Pipes: EBITDA = tonnes x (net realisation/kg - PVC resin cost/kg - conversion), with inventory gains or losses on resin; Tiles: revenue = volume (own, subsidiary, outsourced) x realisation per sqm, margin set by gas cost per sqm and Morbi price gap; Panels: EBITDA/CBM = realisation - timber, resin and fixed cost per CBM at a given utilisation.

price_drivers.driver: Raw material cost and pass-through (PVC resin, gas, timber and resin)
price_drivers.why: PVC price swings create inventory gains or losses at pipe makers; gas at ~Rs70-91/SCM sets tile cost; timber and urea set MDF margin.

price_drivers.driver: Volume growth versus market and channel restocking
price_drivers.why: Pipe volume growth of 19-24% in 2Q came off a low base and channel restocking; sustained double digit growth gives market share gains.

price_drivers.driver: Morbi competition and price gap (tiles); capacity cycle (MDF)
price_drivers.why: Branded tile premium over Morbi narrowed after the 2026 gas spike, helping Kajaria; MDF overcapacity caps price and Century's MDF margin.
Bathware and adhesives (Kajaria adhesive target Rs2.4bn FY27) carry better RoCE and dilute tile cyclicality.

kpis.name: Volume growth (pipes in tonnes, tiles in MSM, panels in CBM)
kpis.definition: Unit volume growth by product line, split where relevant into own, subsidiary and outsourced supply and organic versus restocking.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Volume ahead of the market (Kajaria +10% vs ~5-6%) signals share gain; growth driven by channel restocking after a PVC price bottom reverses next quarter.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'volume' (Supreme, Astral, Kajaria, Century publish volumes); get_financials revenue as a cross-check; Motilal Oswal results tables in the report library carry 8 quarters.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for Sales; volume forecasts only from broker models and company guidance in transcripts (Supreme FY27 ~10%, Prince double digit).
kpis.traps: Pipe volumes exclude trading and include only plastic pipes in some decks; Somany series broken by JV reclassification; Orient Bell gives growth % only.

kpis.name: Segment EBITDA margin (pipes, tiles, plywood, MDF)
kpis.definition: Segment operating profit margin on revenue, ex other income, with the segment's own basis stated.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Margin miss against consensus drove Astral (13.1%), Supreme and Cera (12.2%) to the miss list despite strong volumes; margin recovery guidance (Astral 15%, Cera 13-14%) is what the stock is priced on.
kpis.history_source: get_financials segment disclosures; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA margin'; Motilal Oswal and other broker results notes for segment tables.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates EBITDA (company level); segment margins from broker models and management guidance (Kajaria 18-20%, Cera 13-14%, CPBI MDF 20% by FY29).
kpis.traps: Gross margin has two bases at tile makers (after materials, or also after fuel); Supreme reports EBIT in some commentary; inventory gain or loss on PVC inside margin.

kpis.name: Realisation per unit and price actions
kpis.definition: Net revenue per kg, sqm or CBM, split into price and mix, with hikes announced versus retained.
kpis.formula: Segment revenue / volume; price action % and date
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Kajaria revenue +24% on volume +10% shows price-led growth after the gas pass-through; if volume does not hold, realisation reverts after three years of decline (FY24-26).
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'realisation' or 'NSR'; transcripts for hikes; derive from get_financials segment revenue and volume.
kpis.estimate_source: Not in Bloomberg consensus; broker models and company statements (CPBI plywood hikes 2-3% from Nov-26).
kpis.traps: Never divide total revenue by tile volume (includes bathware, adhesives); PVC pass-through is price-neutral to margin per kg.

kpis.name: Key input cost (gas Rs/SCM, PVC resin Rs/kg, timber/resin)
kpis.definition: Delivered price of the dominant input for each product and its share of cost.
kpis.formula: Reported or tracked input price; fuel cost per sqm produced for tiles
kpis.why_it_moves_price: PVC falls cause inventory losses and channel destocking, rises cause gains; Morbi gas at Rs90/SCM vs Kajaria's ~Rs70 blended widened its advantage; timber +10% is about 3pp of MDF margin.
kpis.history_source: get_commodity_prices for PVC proxies where available; transcripts via search_research for gas by region and fuel mix (Kajaria call); broker sector notes (ICICI Sec tiles reports) for Morbi gas.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; house view from commodity series and management commentary.
kpis.traps: Gas prints may be gas only or blended with biofuel; PVC lag creates inventory effects counted in EBITDA.

kpis.name: Utilisation and capacity additions
kpis.definition: Production divided by time-weighted commercial capacity, with new line ramp.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MDF and tile capacity coming up (Kajaria +28% by 1QFY28; ~400k CBM MDF in 2HFY27) pressures price when utilisation is below breakeven; high utilisation supports operating leverage.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'capacity' and 'utilisation'; transcripts for plant start dates.
kpis.estimate_source: Company guidance in transcripts; broker models; no consensus.
kpis.traps: Capacity bases are restated (Kajaria 90.5 to 82.7 MSM); thickness-normalised capacity at MDF makers.

kpis.name: Adjacency revenue and margin (bathware, adhesives, laminates)
kpis.definition: Revenue and margin of newer lines against stated targets.
kpis.formula: Adjacency revenue / total revenue; adjacency EBITDA margin
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Kajaria's adhesive target of Rs2.4bn in FY27 and Rs4.0bn in FY28 and Cera's 13-14% margin path justify premium multiples; misses hurt re-rating.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'bathware' or 'adhesive'; get_financials segment lines.
kpis.estimate_source: Management guidance in transcripts; broker models only.
kpis.traps: Targets slipped before (bathware target missed ~14%); adjacencies distort per-unit tile metrics.

macro_inputs.series: Morbi gas and propane price, tile exports
macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes in the library (ICICI Sec tiles); company transcripts
macro_inputs.why: Sets Morbi cost curve and tile price gap

macro_inputs.series: Timber, urea and melamine; MDF imports
macro_inputs.source: Broker sector reports (JM EXIM, Investec); transcripts
macro_inputs.why: MDF and plywood margin; import ceiling on price
Late-cycle demand for tiles and panels

valuation_anchor: P/E on core EPS against own post-2024 band for pipes and tiles; EV/EBITDA on mid-cycle clean EBITDA and EV/CBM against replacement cost for MDF.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL: PVC price stability and channel restocking for pipe margin recovery (Astral toward 15% from 3Q), Kajaria's double-digit tile volume and 18-20% margin, Cera's 13-14% margin on RM pass-through, and Century's plywood margin moderation on marketing spend with MDF margin pressure from new capacity.
